note: Volvo excavator digging rock with operator in cab; a person stands a few metres behind its counterweight, in the tail-swing blind spot.
standard: Dataset rule 4: worker in the blind spot or operating radius of an excavator in operation or with an operator inside. Yes needs a worker on foot within the arm's reach or tail swing of an excavator that is working or manned; unsure when distance (perspective) or operation cannot be judged.
